title: Distribution of doubling times across the ensemble (cap-immune)
interpretation: Histogram of the cap-immune instantaneous doubling time t2 = ln(2)/mu over all emitted timesteps in the 2-seed x 3-gen ensemble (many samples). Tight distribution centred near ~52 min; immune to the final-generation step-cap truncation that biased the old per-cell-span histogram toward a spurious low-end bin.
command: scripts/render_showcase2.py doubling_time_{line,hist}: cap-immune instantaneous t2=ln(2)/mu trace over the clean showcase2 sweep parquet; Altair->PNG/SVG via vl_convert.
